newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Euroairport air cargo up 15 percent in Jan-August.
newsitem.headline: Euroairport air cargo up 15 percent in Jan-August.

text.p: Global cargo traffic handled at Basle-Mulhouse-Freiburg airport, situated on the French-Swiss border, in the first eight months of 1996, totalled 58,019 tonnes, an increase of 15 percent on the same period last year, airport authority figures show.
January-August 1996 airfreight traffic handled at the airport, officially known as EuroAirport, totalled 32,025 tonnes, an increase of 33 percent on 1995 levels.
In the past 18 months, full-freighter services have been launched from EuroAirport to Chicago, Atlanta, Delhi, Seoul and Istanbul.
Later this month, Swissair said it will launch a weekly McDonnell Douglas DC10-30 freighter service between EuroAirport and Sao Paulo.
January-August 1996 trucked airfreight traffic was stable on last year's levels at 25,994 tonnes.
Postal traffic totalled 2,211 tonnes, up nine percent on the first eight months of 1995. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
